programme.title: Nekā deklarējama: Austrālija 15
programme.desc: Nedeklarētas lietas, aizliegtas vielas, mēģinājumi nelegāli iebraukt valstī, svešu cilvēku pases, aizdomīgi sūtījumi – tā ir robežkontroles darbinieku ikdiena. Viņu uzdevums ir identificēt un novērst noziedzīgas darbības – konfiscēt narkotikas, ieročus un citas aizliegtas lietas, neielaist valstī noziedzniekus un cilvēkus, kuri varētu mēģināt nelegāli uzturēties Austrālijā.

programme.title: Doktors Hauss 8
programme.desc: Seriāla pēdējā sezona ir klāt! Medicīnas spožākais prāts atgriežas, turpinot atklāt nopietnu slimību cēloņus un darot visu, arī pārkāpjot robežas, lai glābtu pacientu dzīvības. Ir pagājis gads, kopš Hauss ietriecās Kadijas mājā. Tagad viņš atrodas aiz restēm, bet jau pavisam drīz pārlieku tiešais un atklātais ārsts būs uz brīvām kājām. Atgriežoties ierastajā ārsta ikdienā, viņš atklās, ka daudz kas pa šo laiku tomēr ir mainījies. Tomēr pats Hauss nav kļuvis citāds - viņš turpina iet savu skarbā vīra ceļu un vājš kļūst tikai dažu sieviešu priekšā... Kad Hausa iemīļotā ielasmeita Emīlija nolemj precēties, viņš ir apņēmības pilns izjaukt sievietes vēl plaukumā esošās attiecības.

programme.title: Zaļknābis pie stūres
programme.desc: Viņš ir ļoti jauns un prot ļoti ātri un labi braukt, kad ātri jātiek prom no nozieguma vietas. Tas ir neviens cits kā labākais auto vadītājs, saukts par Mazo. Kad Mazais satiek savu sapņu meiteni, viņš vēlas pamest noziedzīgo pasauli. Taču tas nav tik vienkārši kā šķiet, kad Mazais tiek iesaistīts vēl vienā noziegumā, kas apdraud viņa dzīvi, mīlestību un brīvību.

programme.title: Cilvēks ar dzelzs dūrēm
programme.desc: Kopš ierašanās mazā ķīniešu ciematā, jaunajam kalējam ir pilnas rokas darba, nodrošinot ar ieročiem karojošos klanus. Kad klanu cīņas izvēršas īstā karā, svešinieks izmanto visu savu enerģiju un zināšanas, lai pats pārvērstos par ieroci. Palīdzot vietējiem ļaudīm cīnīties ar nežēlīgajiem pretiniekiem, viņš saprot, ka viņam jāizmanto savas īpašās spējas, lai kļūtu par šo cilvēku glābēju un atbrīvotāju.

programme.title: Sūklis Bobs Kvadrātbiksis 13
programme.desc: Sūkļa Boba Kvadrātbikša un viņa zemūdens draugu piedzīvojumi turpinās! Atšķirībā no citiem Bobs Kvadrātbiksis ikdienas izaicinājumus nerisina loģiski, viņam patīk atrast neparastus veidus, kā tikt galā ar vienkāršām situācijām. Sūkļa labie nodomi, dedzīgā attieksme pret dzīvi un pārgalvīgās idejas rada haosu visā zemūdens pasaulē.

programme.title: Vilcienā cauri pasaulei 3
programme.desc: Aizraujošs ceļojumu raidījums, kas aicina izbraukāt pasaules iespaidīgākos un neaizmirstamākos vilcienu maršrutus. Raidījuma galvenais varonis ir vilciens — tas ved cauri elpu aizraujošām ainavām, vēsturiskām pilsētām un nomaļiem reģioniem, kur pārvietošanās pa sliedēm nav tikai, lai nokļūtu no viena punkta līdz otram – tas ir īsts piedzīvojums. Raidījums apvieno ainaviskus skatus, kultūras stāstus un dzelzceļa vēsturi, ļaujot atklāt gan pasaulslavenus, gan mazāk zināmus maršrutus, pa ceļam iepazīstot vietējās tradīcijas, cilvēkus paradumus, arhitektūru un inženiertehniskos risinājumus, kas padara katru braucienu unikālu.

programme.title: 15 jautājumi 2
programme.desc: Erudīcijas spēle katram darbdienu vakaram! Katru vakaru 15 jautājumi, viens uzvarētājs un 150 eiro balva. Spēli vada radio personība, dīdžejs un pasākumu vadītājs Magnuss Eriņš, bet par vakara erudītākā cilvēka titulu sacenšas divi dalībnieki. Noteikumi ir pavisam vienkārši – katram dalībniekam priekšā ir poga, kas kļūst aktīva, līdzko izskanējis jautājums. Kurš pirmais šo pogu nospiež, tas izvēlas jautājuma likteni – vai pats vēlas uz to atbildēt cerībā nopelnīt divus punktus, vai arī pirmo iespēju dot konkurentam, lai pats pēc tam mēģinātu tikt pie viena punkta. Kurš atbildējis pirmais un pareizi, tas tiek pie diviem punktiem, kurš otrais – pie viena, bet par nepareizu atbildi punkti nepienākas. Kuram vakara beigās vairāk punktu, tas arī uzvarētājs! Uzvarētājs saņem 150 eiro balvu un iespēju piedalīties nākamā vakara spēlē.

programme.title: Sadursme 360
programme.desc: Sadursme 360 ir 10 minūšu ikdienas operatīvo drošības dienestu ziņu raidījums ar galveno uzsvaru uz ceļu satiksmes drošību.

programme.title: Viens pret visiem
programme.desc: Erudīcijas un taktikas spēlē “Viens pret visiem” spēles dalībnieki stāsies duelī ar zināmām Latvijas personībām, katram liekot galdā savu trumpi – slavenībām talkā būs erudīti eksperti, bet pretiniekam – būs pirmais gājiens un iespēja taktiski izvēlēties tēmas, tostarp sev neērtākos jautājumus piespēlējot slavenībai. Katrā spēlē būs jauns spēlētājs, bet sabiedrībā zināmās personības komanda būs nemainīga visu nedēļu. Par spēles tempu, azartu un jautājumiem savukārt parūpēsies Gustavs Terzens. Kurš no dalībniekiem savu trumpi izspēlēs gudrāk? Vai uzvaru izšķirs zināšanas, taktika vai spēja riskēt īstajā brīdī?

programme.title: Gandrīz ideālas vakariņas
programme.desc: Garšīgais ciemošanās šovs “Gandrīz ideālas vakariņas” atkal priecē skatītājus! Četri dalībnieki nedēļas garumā cits pie cita viesosies, gatavos vakariņas un centīsies pārsteigt ar gardiem ēdieniem, radošām idejām un īpašu vakara noskaņu. Taču ne vienmēr viss noritēs pēc plāna – amizanti starpgadījumi un negaidīti pārsteigumi būs daļa no vakariņu šarma. Šova jaunajā sezonā savas mājokļu durvis vērs sabiedrībā zināmas personības, bet katra vakara noslēgumā viesi vērtēs gan ēdienus, gan radīto gaisotni. Pēc četriem vakariem augstāko punktu skaitu ieguvušais dalībnieks kļūs par nedēļas uzvarētāju un saņems vērtīgu balvu. Skatītājus sagaida sirsnīgas tikšanās, humors, pārsteigumi un iespēja ielūkoties iemīļotu personību ikdienā – šoreiz nevis uz skatuves vai ekrānā, bet pie vakariņu galda.

programme.title: SOKO Leipciga 21
programme.desc: Leipcigas policijas īpašā vienība SOKO – labākie no labākajiem, augstas klases profesionāļi, izmeklētāji, kas ķeras pie darba, lai atrisinātu smagākos un sarežģītākos pilsētā paveiktos noziegumus. Vienību vada ambiciozā vecākā policijas komisāre Ina Cimermane, kas kopā ar savu uzticamo komandu Janu Meibahu, Tomu Kovalski un Olīviju Faredi izmeklē smagus noziegumus – gan rūpīgi plānotas slepkavības, gan emociju karstumā paveiktas. Lai notvertu noziedzniekus, komanda piesaista valsts izcilākos ekspertus un labākos konsultantus. Galvenajās lomās: Melānija Marške, Marko Girnts, Štefans Šrūders, Nilama Faruka

programme.title: CSI Lasvegasa 5
programme.desc: Buldozers uzrok līķus, kas pārklāti ar darvu. CSI izmeklētājiem jācenšas atklāt ne tikai slepkava, bet arī nogalināto identitāte. Notikuma izmeklēšana Sāras emociju pasauli sagriež kājām gaisā, viņa tiek atstādināta no saviem tiešajiem darba pienākumiem.

programme.title: Īstais CSI: Maiami
programme.desc: Dokumentālais seriāls, kas piedāvā ieskatītos reālu slepkavību izmeklēšanā. Brutālas, nežēlīgas un neizprotamas slepkavības, kas šokē Maiami iedzīvotājus – kas un kāpēc tās paveica? CSI Maiami detektīvi atklāj, kā puzles gabaliņi tika likti kopā, lai sadzītu pēdas vainīgajiem.

programme.title: Četri uz koferiem 4
programme.desc: Ceļojuma vadību pārņem Jānis Jubalts un sarīko visiem īstu pāsteigumu. Pēc lieliskas dienas kalnu pilsētā Kusko seko briesmīga nakts autobusā, ar kuru pārvietojas tikai vietējie. Samanta Tīna atsakās runāt un visu ceļu autobusā pavada sejas maskā un saules brillēs. Nākamais rīts neko labāku nesola - līst lietus, bet četrotnei paredzēta nakšņošana uz salas Titikaka ezera vidū, kur nav nedz apkures, nedz siltā ūdens.

programme.title: NCIS: Losandželosa 4
programme.desc: Slavenā NCIS Losandželosas īpašā vienība ķeras pie darba! Augsti kvalificēti, pieredzējuši un spējīgi – viņi tiek piesaistīti lietās, kurās uz spēles ir valsts drošība. Komandu vada augumā necilā, tomēr ļoti spējīgā Hetija, kuras apskaužamās zināšanas, skarbā attieksme un ciešais skatiens iedveš bailes kā noziedzniekiem, tā viņas padotajiem. Īpašais aģents Džī Kalens iepriekš stradājis FIB, Narkotiku apkarošanas administrācijā un Centrālajā izlūkošanas pārvaldē, bet viņa pārinieks Sems Hanna ir ar militāru un sporta pieredzi un kopā ar savu uzticamo komandu viņi ir neapturami un spēj aizturēt pat visrūdītākos noziedzniekus. Galvenajās lomās: Kriss O’Donels, LL Cool J, Linda Hanta

programme.title: CSI Maiami 1
programme.desc: Horācijam, Timam un Kalijai jāizmeklē universitātes profesora slepkavība. Vīrietis ne vien pakārts kokā, bet ir arī nežēlīgi sakropļots. Pirmās aizdomas krīt uz viņa savdabīgajiem studentiem, kopskaitā trīspadsmit. Bet Ērika un Meganas uzmanības lokā nonākusi mašīna, kura tiek izvilkta no kādas ūdenstilpnes. Tās bagāžniekā atrasts miris vīrietis.

programme.title: Līmenis
programme.desc: Latvijā vēl nebijuša mēroga sociālās realitātes spēle, kas 35 dienas 24 stundas diennaktī ļaus skatītājiem reāllaikā sekot līdzi tam, kādi brīnumi notiek, kad tā dalībniekus, tādus pašus cilvēkus kā ikviens no mums, sadala divās krasi atšķirīgās pasaulēs. Vieni baudīs komfortu un privilēģijas, kamēr otri dzīvos daudz skarbākos apstākļos, strādās, pelnīs un cīnīsies par iespēju uzlabot dzīves apstākļus. Abas pasaules būs cieši saistītas, bet spēles gaitu nemitīgi mainīs skatītāju balsojumi, izbalsošanas, dalībnieku rotācija un iespēja pāriet no viena līmeņa uz otru. Līmenis - tā ir sociālā piramīda realitātes šova formātā, kurā tiek pārbaudītas ne tikai dalībnieku izdzīvošanas spējas, bet arī viņu attiecības, vērtības un priekšstati par taisnīgumu. Līmenis 24/7 skatāms tiešraidē Tet+, bet televīzijas skatītāji var sekot līdzi ikdienas 30 minūšu epizodēm un iknedēļas izbalsošanas tiešraidēm.

Šova jaunajā sezonā savas mājokļu durvis vērs sabiedrībā zināmas personības, bet katra vakara noslēgumā viesi vērtēs gan ēdienus, gan radīto gaisotni. Pēc četriem vakariem augstāko punktu skaitu ieguvušais dalībnieks kļūs par nedēļas uzvarētāju un saņems vērtīgu balvu. Skatītājus sagaida sirsnīgas tikšanās, humors, pārsteigumi un iespēja ielūkoties iemīļotu personību ikdienā – šoreiz nevis uz skatuves vai ekrānā, bet pie vakariņu galda.

programme.title: 360 Ziņas
programme.desc: 360 Ziņas ir dinamisks un mūsdienīgs TOP7 dienas svarīgāko Latvijas un pasaules notikumu apskats, kas palīdz saprast, kāpēc tas ir svarīgi tieši tev. TOP7 apvieno ātru tempu, saprotamu valodu, dažādus viedokļus un cilvēku pieredzes, kā arī skaidrojošu pieeju bez informācijas pārslodzes un liekvārdības, palīdzot orientēties informatīvajā troksnī un īsā laikā ar TOP7 iegūt skaidru priekšstatu par dienas būtiskāko.

programme.title: Viens pret visiem
programme.desc: Erudīcijas un taktikas spēlē “Viens pret visiem” spēles dalībnieki stāsies duelī ar zināmām Latvijas personībām, katram liekot galdā savu trumpi – slavenībām talkā būs erudīti eksperti, bet pretiniekam – būs pirmais gājiens un iespēja taktiski izvēlēties tēmas, tostarp sev neērtākos jautājumus piespēlējot slavenībai. Katrā spēlē būs jauns spēlētājs, bet sabiedrībā zināmās personības komanda būs nemainīga visu nedēļu. Par spēles tempu, azartu un jautājumiem savukārt parūpēsies Gustavs Terzens. Kurš no dalībniekiem savu trumpi izspēlēs gudrāk? Vai uzvaru izšķirs zināšanas, taktika vai spēja riskēt īstajā brīdī?

programme.title: Slavenības. Bez filtra 15
programme.desc: “Slavenības. Bez filtra” atkal ver durvis slavenību dzīvei bez izskaistināšanas tur, kur emocijas, attiecību drāmas un skaļākie ikdienas mirkļi notiek pa īstam. Viņi uzdrīkstas iet savu ceļu un būt paši, īsti un drosmīgi! Ikviens varēs pievienoties Kaspara un Olgas Kambalu, latgalietes Margaritas Kolosovas, dzejnieces Magones Liedeskalnas un influenceru Sindijas Bokānes un Nika Endziņa ikdienai, kā arī raudzīt jaunas sejas, tostarp skaistuma dīvu Kristīni Lindenblati.

programme.title: Caur ērkšķiem uz... 8.sezona
programme.desc: Attiecību eksperta Kristapa Ozoliņa lekcija par seksu, intimitāti un personiskajām robežām “Caur ērkšķiem uz…” dalībniecēm liek sastapties ar jautājumiem, uz kuriem ne visas gatavas atbildēt - Ineta pat lūdz iespēju nepiedalīties. Tantras nodarbībā uzticēšanās citai citai kļūst par īstu pārbaudījumu, bet iepazīšanās ar intīmprecēm kautrību mij ar drosmīgiem jokiem. Vakaru noslēdz enerģētisks biodejas rituāls, bet nākamajā dienā pārrunātās robežas nākas pārbaudīt sadzīviski: Martas ieilgusī tetovēšana kemperī un Skaidrītes palikšana aiz durvīm aizsāk skaļu konfliktu. Ginta un Līga iesaistās viņas aizstāvībā, un līdzšinējās draudzības sāk šķobīties. Spriedze nepazūd arī nākamajā dienā - pat kemperu mazgāšanas laikā uzvirmo pārmetumi, bet sarunas arvien biežāk aizved pie vietām finālā. Vai iespējams, ka balsojumā vakardienas sabiedrotās jau kļūs par tām, pret kurām tiek vērstas dalībnieču balsis?

programme.title: Non-Stop: tiešais reiss
programme.desc: Spriedzes filma ar Laiemu Nīsonu un Džulianu Mūru. Transatlantiskā avioreisa Ņujorka - Londona laikā ASV aviācijas policijas priekšnieks Bils Marks saņem vairākas īsziņas ar prasību pārskaitīt 150 miljonus dolāru uz kādu ārzonu kontu. Pretējā gadījumā tiek draudēts ik pēc 20 minūtēm nogalināt kādu pasažieri. Kad atklājas, ka konts ir atvērts uz paša Marka vārda, viņš tiek turēts aizdomās par lidmašīnas nolaupīšanu.

programme.title: Sūklis Bobs Kvadrātbiksis 13
programme.desc: Sūkļa Boba Kvadrātbikša un viņa zemūdens draugu piedzīvojumi turpinās! Atšķirībā no citiem Bobs Kvadrātbiksis ikdienas izaicinājumus nerisina loģiski, viņam patīk atrast neparastus veidus, kā tikt galā ar vienkāršām situācijām. Sūkļa labie nodomi, dedzīgā attieksme pret dzīvi un pārgalvīgās idejas rada haosu visā zemūdens pasaulē.

programme.desc: Sūkļa Boba Kvadrātbikša un viņa zemūdens draugu piedzīvojumi turpinās! programme.title: Vilcienā cauri pasaulei 3
programme.desc: Aizraujošs ceļojumu raidījums, kas aicina izbraukāt pasaules iespaidīgākos un neaizmirstamākos vilcienu maršrutus. Raidījuma galvenais varonis ir vilciens — tas ved cauri elpu aizraujošām ainavām, vēsturiskām pilsētām un nomaļiem reģioniem, kur pārvietošanās pa sliedēm nav tikai, lai nokļūtu no viena punkta līdz otram – tas ir īsts piedzīvojums. Raidījums apvieno ainaviskus skatus, kultūras stāstus un dzelzceļa vēsturi, ļaujot atklāt gan pasaulslavenus, gan mazāk zināmus maršrutus, pa ceļam iepazīstot vietējās tradīcijas, cilvēkus paradumus, arhitektūru un inženiertehniskos risinājumus, kas padara katru braucienu unikālu.

programme.title: 15 jautājumi 2
programme.desc: Erudīcijas spēle katram darbdienu vakaram! Katru vakaru 15 jautājumi, viens uzvarētājs un 150 eiro balva. Spēli vada radio personība, dīdžejs un pasākumu vadītājs Magnuss Eriņš, bet par vakara erudītākā cilvēka titulu sacenšas divi dalībnieki. Noteikumi ir pavisam vienkārši – katram dalībniekam priekšā ir poga, kas kļūst aktīva, līdzko izskanējis jautājums. Kurš pirmais šo pogu nospiež, tas izvēlas jautājuma likteni – vai pats vēlas uz to atbildēt cerībā nopelnīt divus punktus, vai arī pirmo iespēju dot konkurentam, lai pats pēc tam mēģinātu tikt pie viena punkta. Kurš atbildējis pirmais un pareizi, tas tiek pie diviem punktiem, kurš otrais – pie viena, bet par nepareizu atbildi punkti nepienākas. Kuram vakara beigās vairāk punktu, tas arī uzvarētājs! Uzvarētājs saņem 150 eiro balvu un iespēju piedalīties nākamā vakara spēlē.

programme.title: Ceļot Bez Robežām 3
programme.desc: Ceļot bez robežām rudens sezonā būs iespēja baudīt Eiropu no Ziemeļiem līdz Dienvidiem – no skaistajiem Lofotu salu kalnu skatiem līdz saulainajai Krētai. Kā jau ierasts, neiztiksim arī bez slēpošanas kūrortiem, un šoreiz tie būs trīs – Slovākijas Jasna un Itālijas Trentino reģiona kūrorti. Balkānu valstis mūs pārsteigs gan pozitīvā, gan ne tik pozitīvā veidā – Bosnijas un Hercegovinas kultūra un vēsture mīsies ar reliģiju, bet Kosovā būs savs īpašais stāsts. Kad mājās dzimusi ideja tikt pie vēl viena sunīša, laiks kāpt auto un doties uz Rumāniju tam pakaļ. Tā top jauna sērija – Eiropas piedzīvojums ceļā pēc suņa. Vasaras noslēgums ar kemperi Norvēģijā, aiz Polārā loka uz Lofotu salām, būs burvīgu skatu pārpilns, savukārt Santorini vulkāna svētki un Krētas vasaras turpinājums sasildīs arī skatītājus.

programme.title: Dr. Sirmais S02
programme.desc: Dr. Sirmais iedvesmos ģimenes savus iecienītākos ēdienus gatavot dažādāk, vienlaikus lētāk, ātrāk un gudrāk! Pie pavāra Mārtiņa Sirmā katru nedēļu viesosies kāda sabiedrībā atpazīstama persona kopā ar ģimeni, lai apspriestu savus ēšanas paradumus un kopīgi pagatavotu maltītes veselai darba nedēļai. Pirms tam viesiem būs jāizdara mājas darbs un jādokumentē piecu darba dienu vakariņas visos sagatavošanās posmos - no veikala apmeklējuma līdz pat maltītes servēšanai. Mārtiņš Sirmais analizēs viesu ikdienu, lai vēlāk sniegtu vērtīgus padomus, kā atvieglot iepirkšanās un gatavošanas procesu, kā arī kā ēdienu padarīt vēl gardāku. Visu to, ko viesi būs gatavojuši mājās, viņi gatavos vēlreiz kopā ar pavāru Mārtiņu Sirmo, bet nu jau uzlabotās versijās, turklāt saņemot ieteikumus, kā gatavošanu padarīt arī maciņam draudzīgāku, vienlaikus tam veltot mazāk laika.

programme.title: SOKO Leipciga 21
programme.desc: Leipcigas policijas īpašā vienība SOKO – labākie no labākajiem, augstas klases profesionāļi, izmeklētāji, kas ķeras pie darba, lai atrisinātu smagākos un sarežģītākos pilsētā paveiktos noziegumus. Vienību vada ambiciozā vecākā policijas komisāre Ina Cimermane, kas kopā ar savu uzticamo komandu Janu Meibahu, Tomu Kovalski un Olīviju Faredi izmeklē smagus noziegumus – gan rūpīgi plānotas slepkavības, gan emociju karstumā paveiktas. Lai notvertu noziedzniekus, komanda piesaista valsts izcilākos ekspertus un labākos konsultantus. Galvenajās lomās: Melānija Marške, Marko Girnts, Štefans Šrūders, Nilama Faruka

programme.title: CSI Lasvegasa 5
programme.desc: Mirusi sieviete, kura salīdzinoši nesen kļuvusi par māti un bijusi teju apsēsta ar savu jaundzimušo. Tikmēr kalnos vardarbīgi saplosīts kāds mednieks. Pavisam netālu no viņa atrasts uzšķērsts Aļaskas brūnais lācis. Kas mežā noticis?

programme.title: Stāt! Kubas robežkontrole
programme.desc: Dokumentālā filma par robežkontroles ikdienu Kubas galvaspilsētas Havanas lidostā. Filmēšanas grupa seko, kā robežkontrolei izdodas aizturēt narkotiku pārvadātājus, ieroču tirgoņus, naudas atmazgātājus un krāpniekus. Kubas elites klases drošībniek strādā nepagurdami, lai sargātu savas valsts robežu.

programme.title: Stāt! Kubas robežkontrole
programme.desc: Dokumentālā filma par robežkontroles ikdienu Kubas galvaspilsētas Havanas lidostā. programme.title: Četri uz koferiem 4
programme.desc: Laura Reinika vadībā ceļotāji atgriežas Peru galvaspilsētā Limā. Izrādās, ka pilsētā ir Latvijai veltīts laukums. Diemžēl restorāns, uz kuru slavenības plāno doties vakariņās, ir slēgts. Reiniks pārējiem sarīko neaizmirstamu piedzīvojumu - iespēju palūkoties uz Limu no putna lidojuma, savukārt pēdējā ceļojuma vakarā visi tiek uzlūgti smalkās vakariņās pie Latvijas goda konsula Peru.

programme.title: NCIS: Losandželosa 5
programme.desc: Slavenā NCIS Losandželosas īpašā vienība ķeras pie darba! Augsti kvalificēti, pieredzējuši un spējīgi – viņi tiek piesaistīti lietās, kurās uz spēles ir valsts drošība. Komandu vada augumā necilā, tomēr ļoti spējīgā Hetija, kuras apskaužamās zināšanas, skarbā attieksme un ciešais skatiens iedveš bailes kā noziedzniekiem, tā viņas padotajiem. Īpašais aģents Džī Kalens iepriekš stradājis FIB, Narkotiku apkarošanas administrācijā un Centrālajā izlūkošanas pārvaldē, bet viņa pārinieks Sems Hanna ir ar militāru un sporta pieredzi un kopā ar savu uzticamo komandu viņi ir neapturami un spēj aizturēt pat visrūdītākos noziedzniekus. Galvenajās lomās: Kriss O’Donels, LL Cool J, Linda Hanta

programme.title: CSI Maiami 1
programme.desc: Kamēr Horācijs un Kalija mēģina noskaidrot, kurš vainojams kādas jaunas meitenes nāvē - viņas līķis atrasts netālu no nepilngadīgo pāraudzināšanas nometnes meitenēm. Tikmēr Ēriks un Tims izmeklē kādu savdabīgu nāves gadījumu - vīrietis ticis sadedzināts no iekšpuses.

programme.title: Līmenis
programme.desc: Latvijā vēl nebijuša mēroga sociālās realitātes spēle, kas 35 dienas 24 stundas diennaktī ļaus skatītājiem reāllaikā sekot līdzi tam, kādi brīnumi notiek, kad tā dalībniekus, tādus pašus cilvēkus kā ikviens no mums, sadala divās krasi atšķirīgās pasaulēs. Vieni baudīs komfortu un privilēģijas, kamēr otri dzīvos daudz skarbākos apstākļos, strādās, pelnīs un cīnīsies par iespēju uzlabot dzīves apstākļus. Abas pasaules būs cieši saistītas, bet spēles gaitu nemitīgi mainīs skatītāju balsojumi, izbalsošanas, dalībnieku rotācija un iespēja pāriet no viena līmeņa uz otru. Līmenis - tā ir sociālā piramīda realitātes šova formātā, kurā tiek pārbaudītas ne tikai dalībnieku izdzīvošanas spējas, bet arī viņu attiecības, vērtības un priekšstati par taisnīgumu. Līmenis 24/7 skatāms tiešraidē Tet+, bet televīzijas skatītāji var sekot līdzi ikdienas 30 minūšu epizodēm un iknedēļas izbalsošanas tiešraidēm.

programme.title: Dr. Sirmais S03
programme.desc: Dr. Sirmais savā virtuvē uzņems visnotaļ harizmātisku viesi – dāmu mīluli, dziedātāju Ainaru Bumbieri. Šī tikšanās solās būt ne tikai izklaidējoša, bet arī izzinoša, turklāt skatītājiem būs iespēja iepazīties ar neierastām ēdienu kombinācijām. Dziedātājs būs gatavs pat neparastākajiem eksperimentiem, tostarp nobaudīt rapšu eļļu tieši no tasītes, lai pārbaudītu tās vērtīgās īpašības. Raidījuma laikā abi kungi pievērsīsies kulinārijas klasikai, sagatavojot iespaidīgu maltīšu klāstu – no sulīgas vistas un maiga laša līdz sātīgiem makaroniem un perfekti ceptam steikam. Īpaša uzmanība tiks veltīta detaļām, pagatavojot trīs dažādas salātu mērces, kas spēj pilnībā mainīt maltītes garšas nianses. Atliek vien noskaidrot, vai šarmantajam dziedātājam daktera stingrie, bet vērtīgie ieteikumi liksies noderīgi un vai viņš būs gatavs tos ieviest arī savā ikdienā?

programme.title: Saldais pārītis. Ir bērni
programme.desc: Pie skatītājiem pēc vairāk nekā desmit gadu pārtraukuma atgriežas iemīļotais seriāls “Saldais pārītis” – ar jauniem Simonas un Filipa piedzīvojumiem, dzirkstošu humoru un asprātīgām situācijām, kas “līdz kaulam” atklāj patiesību attiecībās starp vīrieti un sievieti jeb to, ka patiešām “dzīvojam uz atšķirīgām planētām.” Galvenajās lomās iejutušies Artūrs Skrastiņš un Sandra Kļaviņa, kuru varoņi par šiem gadiem kļuvuši pieaugušāki un tikuši pie bērniem, taču joprojām risina sadzīviskas un amizantas problēmas, kuras labi pazīstamas ikvienam.

programme.title: Saldais pārītis. Ir bērni
programme.desc: Pie skatītājiem pēc vairāk nekā desmit gadu pārtraukuma atgriežas iemīļotais seriāls “Saldais pārītis” – ar jauniem Simonas un Filipa piedzīvojumiem, dzirkstošu humoru un asprātīgām situācijām, kas “līdz kaulam” atklāj patiesību attiecībās starp vīrieti un sievieti jeb to, ka patiešām “dzīvojam uz atšķirīgām planētām.” Galvenajās lomās iejutušies Artūrs Skrastiņš un Sandra Kļaviņa, kuru varoņi par šiem gadiem kļuvuši pieaugušāki un tikuši pie bērniem, taču joprojām risina sadzīviskas un amizantas problēmas, kuras labi pazīstamas ikvienam.

programme.title: Izklausies redzēts
programme.desc: No roka dumpinieciskuma līdz latviešu mūzikas zelta fondam – šajā vakarā netrūks ne spilgtu emociju, ne pārsteigumu! Ralfs Eilands iejutīsies grupas „Guns N’ Roses” solista Aksla Rouza tēlā, bet Maksims Busels pārtaps rokmūzikas leģendā Ozijā Osbornā. Ieva Sutugova uzburs Brodvejas mūzikla „Kabarē” atmosfēru, iemiesojoties leģendārajā Laizā Minelli, savukārt Lelde Dreimane pārtaps grupas „Čikāgas piecīši” dalībniekā Armandā Birkenā. Andri Ērgli gaida īpaši emocionāls izaicinājums – pārvērsties dziedātājā Ievā Akuraterē, bet Elīna Fūrmane iejutīsies enerģiskās Olgas Rajeckas tēlā. Savukārt Krisy pārstāvēs mūsdienu Latvijas alternatīvo popmūziku, pārtopot grupas „Kautkaili” solistē Kristīnē Pāžē. Visu šo krāsaino un talantīgo „kokteili“ kopā ar Jāni Šipkevicu un Mārtiņu Eglienu vērtēs grupas „Prāta vētra“ dalībnieks Jānis Jubalts.

programme.title: Pēdējais varonis
programme.desc: Denijam ir vienpadsmit gadu, un katru brīvu brīdi viņš dodas uz kinoteātri, lai kārtējo reizi noskatītos sava iemīļotā grāvējfilmu varoņa Džeka Sleitera piedzīvojumus. Kādu dienu zēnam tiek uzdāvināta brīnumaina biļete, kas ļauj nonākt ekrāna otrā pusē – saistošo notikumu degpunktā. Kopā ar savu iemīļoto personāžu, ievērojamo policistu Džeku Sleiteru, zēnu gaida neticami pārbaudījumi. Viņi nokļūst reālā pasaulē, kur neuzveicamais varonis zaudē savus fantastiskos spēkus un tādēļ var iet bojā kā jebkurš mirstīgais.

programme.title: Jeremy Wade's Dark Waters
programme.desc: Jeremy heads to Australia to investigate an underwater attack. Could it be the work of a giant fresh water predator that many believed to be extinct?

programme.title: Animal Cops Philadelphia
programme.desc: Officers move in to close down a shelter housing hundreds of cats. Some of the animals are already dead and the team must act quickly to save the others.

programme.title: Animal Cops Philadelphia
programme.desc: When trainee agent Derrick Schlitter responds to an emergency call in north Philadelphia, he ends up seeking justice for a puppy left dead in a backyard.

programme.title: Sharkwrecked: Crash Landing

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings have adopted a small exotic fish that’s lively and affectionate and have fun decorating its aquarium. Jealous, Grizzy finds a fish too, but his is expressionless and indifferent to the bear’s efforts to communicate. Grizzy plots to exchange the two fish behind the Lemmings' backs. He puts the affectionate fish in an even bigger aquarium with a pharaonic decor and locks the lid. But the Lemmings have no intention of leaving their friend to Grizzy.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings use all the cans and tins they can get their hands on to build a beach slide. Grizzy, annoyed at not finding his tinned fish to prepare his meal tray, recovers them from the Lemmings. In their struggle, Grizzy loses his badge! Grizzy and the Lemmings now fight over a valuable metal detector that each party needs to accomplish their goal: build a slide or find the beloved badge.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings take a liking to an endangered crab on the beach and decide to shelter it from a seagull who is using its shell to open coconuts. They bring it home to a disgruntled Grizzy, who wants to watch TV in peace while snacking on Cheetos. When the Lemmings turn into full-fledged crab rescuers, the house is soon overrun with crustaceans. Grizzy decides to use the seagull to get rid of the crabs. But the Lemmings - ready to do anything to protect their new friends - embark the entire house, like a raft on water.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings play pirates on a beached boat. Grizzy, who is fishing further down, realizes that with the Lemmings’ boat, he could come closer to a zone that’s teeming with fish. Grizzy takes a malicious pleasure playing pirate himself to unseat the Lemmings and steal their boat. The Lemmings discover a chest containing real pirate belongings. A telescope conjures the owner’s ghost who immediately places his saber and hook at their disposal.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy sets sail with his fishing gear. But he has no intention of fishing: it's a scheme to enjoy a jar of Yummy chocolate spread alone in peace. The Lemmings sense the subterfuge and sink his boat to get the treat, which sinks to the ocean depths. The characters dive in pursuit and discover a school of intelligent crabs that live in an underwater city. Their treasure is a substance that’s even yummier than Yummy.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Irma calls Mr Bean to remind him about the Opera they are attending that night, but of course he has forgotten to buy tickets! He rushes to the box office, but they are sold out. So he hatches a plan to intercept the singer, Signor Parmigiano, at the train station and trick him into playing in his back garden – a private performance for just him and Irma!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean wins two tickets for an exotic cruise and naturally he takes Teddy along for the trip of a lifetime. Once aboard the huge ocean liner Mr Bean soon settles into a life of luxury but while showing off to a new friend Bean becomes ‘man overboard’ and stranded on a dessert island. The hungrier he gets the wilder he becomes and desperate to find a way off the island.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean goes to his favourite china shop to buy a new cup for Teddy but when he opens his wallet he doesn’t have enough money to pay for it. When he sees a poster for the local funfair where the stalls have cash prizes Bean is determined to win himself some money on the Coconut Shy. But after many unsuccessful attempts he realises it’s a fix and lets everyone know about it. Naturally this doesn’t go down well with the stallholder who wants revenge and a chase around the funfair ensues.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean’s electricity supply is cut off when Mrs Wicket sees the cost of her enormous electricity bill. As the snow falls outside Mr Bean’s flat becomes so cold that there are ice cubes in his bath water. Mr Bean has the idea to build a huge wind turbine in the back garden providing his own power. All is going very well until an unexpected storm sends Bean’s wind turbine into overdrive creating a huge surge of electricity and a huge shock for everyone

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean goes to his local bakery to buy a cake but finds he doesn’t have any money. He goes to the bank to use the cash machine but he can’t remember his pin number. When Mr Bean's bankcard is swallowed up by the cash machine there’s only one thing to do - go into the machine and fetch it back. The police are alerted but Bean’s main concern is to get some money and get back to the baker’s before all the cakes are sold.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: When nursing an injured magpie in his room, Mr. Bean learns something the rest of us already know: magpies can’t help stealing anything that sparkles. When the police arrive to investigate the theft of his landlady’s jewellery, it’s not just Mr. Bean that needs to take flight.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 2
programme.desc: Redbird is convinced that nobody likes his eccentric dance moves, but when Toyman traps Robin behind a dance-themed gauntlet, it’s up to the rambunctious rally car to dance his way to victory.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 3
programme.desc: Catwoman has her eyes on the prize at Gotham's big skateboarding competition, and it's up to Robin and Nightwing to stop her -- with some help from Ace!

programme.title: Meet the Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: Bam can't wait to recharge after a long night of heroism in Gotham, but first, the Batwheels need all kinds of help, delaying his much-needed nap just a little bit longer...

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: Finally fed up with monsters and mayhem, Shaggy and Scooby decide to quit the gang and train their replacements in one on-the-job training session, unraveling the mystery of a vampire that's terrorizing a small town.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: After a Giant Houndbeast attacks an elite dog show, the gang goes undercover and enters Scooby in the show in order to solve the mystery.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings find a racket game linked to a prize distributor on a gas station parking lot. The more times you hit the ball without letting it touch the ground, the bigger the prize. With a series of 1,000 consecutive exchanges, the prize is a giant jar of Yummy chocolate spread! Grizzy has no qualms about cheating to win, but the outcome against the Lemmings is never certain. For they have nerves of steel when the stakes are high.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy uses insecticide and a fly swatter to get rid of vermin that are bothering him during his siesta. The Lemmings heal his last victim: a cute little insect they adopt as their house pet. Only problem, their starving mascot only eats wood! The cabin has lots of it, but when Grizzy realizes that an insect is eating his home from the inside, he takes drastic measures to eliminate it permanently.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy is too hot and proposes the Lemmings an exchange: their ventilator, which they use to propel their skateboard in the air, for a baby ostrich Grizzy found outside the cabin and who can tow them. The Lemmings are delighted to play with their new baby friend who is overflowing with energy. But the baby’s parents have a different outlook and do not want their son taking risks. Thinking that Grizzy is the Lemmings’ father, they hold him accountable.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings have placed giant remote-controlled hydraulic jacks under the cabin to transform it into a life-sized rolling ball game. Grizzy, who in inclined to seasickness, tries to put things back in place. The cabin tips over into empty space.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy is disturbed during his nap by a few uncatchable flies which buzz incessantly around his head. When he realizes that the carnivorous plant upon which the Lemmings are playing rodeo feeds off flying insects, he decides to confiscate it and use it as an anti-fly weapon.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings have unearthed a crate of competition boomerangs. They rapidly become pros capable of disarming Grizzy at a distance and ejecting him from the cabin with disconcerting ease. To compete with the precision of the Lemming boomerangs, Grizzy decides to learn archery and becomes the Canadian William Tell.

programme.title: Lamput - Season 3
programme.desc: “Chasing Lamput” turns out to be the ultimate backstage pass; the Docs pursue the orange blob through the dressing room and directly onto the stage of a gigantic stadium rock concert. The crowd goes wild. Which raises questions about their taste in music, to be honest; Skinny plays guitar like he’s gotten himself tangled in the strings (which he has), and Specs’ drumming, well, it’s certainly got passion. No taste, skill or rhythm, but certainly passion. The stage ends up in tatters by the time the actual band arrives. Those Docs are a hard act to follow.

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers - Season 1
programme.desc: Meet Atticus Tinhorn, Clara’s greedy, scheming uncle—who wants to claim Dino Island for himself! There’s just one problem… the Cassidys already call it home! Determined to drive them off once and for all, he cooks up a ridiculous (and ridiculously dangerous) plan: smear Boboberry Jam all over the Cassidys to lure the island’s giant fire ants into carrying them away for good!

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers - Season 1
programme.desc: Uncle Jack and Jon are busy gathering crates of coco-nanas! They know not to go home through Swarm Valley, home to giant dragonflies that love them! Jack and Jon take the safe route, when the Tinhorns swoop in from their hot air balloon and snatch the entire crate from them! Atticus steers the balloon straight toward Swarm Valley, unaware that he’s flying straight into a buzzing nightmare!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean sees Mr Paliwal practising for a local table tennis tournament and decides he wants to enter to try to win the cash prize. He goes home, adapts his dining table into a table tennis table, and designs an ingenious ball-firing machine using a foot pump and vacuum hose. None of this helps much, and Mr Bean worries he’s not improving – but could this new device be adapted and answer his problems?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean sees a new toy car in the window of the local department store Havlotts and decides he must have it. But on the way to the toy department Mr Bean gets stuck in the lift. He tries his best to entertain his fellow passengers but they aren’t very appreciative. How can Mr Bean resolve the situation and get the toy he so desperately wants?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean attempts to build a shady gazebo in the back garden on a scorching hot day. But as he digs into the ground he unearths a huge unexploded bomb. Trying to make Mrs Wicket aware of the danger and save Scrapper and Teddy from being blown to smithereens takes courage nerve and a Bean styled homemade bomb disposal kit.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: Determined to master Beethoven’s symphony, Mr Bean wangles himself a grand piano, a music book, a candelabra and a very patient piano teacher. Liberace, eat your heart out!

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Winter has come! The Baby Lemmings discover the pure joy of sliding and playing on the ice. Their neighbor Baby Moose is not at all as delighted with the new weather conditions as they are – already naturally fearful, he’s thrown into a complete panic when his surroundings turn icy, cold and… sharp! He decides to secure the zone by breaking up all the frozen ice puddles and smashing all the icicles in his vicinity including the Baby Lemmings’ icicles. But his phobia causes him to fall into the middle of a frozen lake, and the Baby Lemmings have to rescue him.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Baby Moose is dismayed by the recklessness of the Baby Lemmings, who wander through the forest oblivious to the dangers around them. Exhausted by having to save them from small dangers, he decides instead to teach them the rudiments of safety and equip them with protective gear. But the Baby Lemmings aren't too keen on this.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The Baby Lemmings are playing a game with a moss ball that falls apart too quickly. They discover a hazel tree with huge hazelnuts that are perfect for making their game even more fun! Their neighbor, Baby Chipmunk, who has the largest stockpile of hazelnuts in the whole forest and a veritable internal radar for detecting them, quickly realizes that the Baby Lemmings have found one. She can’t help but steal it for his own hoard. The Baby Lemmings realize that Baby Chipmunk hates to share so they decide to get their ball back and continue their game. Baby Chipmunk’s hoard is very well protected in a hollow tree, however.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: A Barbarian and his trusty polar bear Krakos stake claim to the entire forest including Bugs' home.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: Bugs and Squeaks head to the African Savannah to visit Squeaks' cousin but first they have to outsmart the very hungry King of the Jungle Thes.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: Bugs is excited for a day of fun in the sun but The Winter Stag shows up delivering Winter long before it's due. Bugs intervenes.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: Squeaks has a last minute card game at Bugs' house. Bugs is thrilled until con-artist Shifty shows up to ruin the fun.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: A very bad parking choice on Fred's part leads the gang to an asteroid mining base in outer space where an alien virus appears to be infecting the crew one by one, turning them into evil skull-headed aliens. The paranoid, terrified gang must try to solve the mystery before the virus reaches them, as well – if it hasn't already!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: To escape a snowstorm, the gang checks into a creepy, massive hotel run by a man very strict about the hotel rules established by his deceased mother. The gang soon discovers the penalty for breaking the hotel rules is a horrifying scolding from the ghost of the owner's mother, herself!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: As Mr Bean settles down to watch his favourite TV programme he hears loud noises from next-door. He moves from house to garden but can’t escape the relentless cacophony of trumpets, electric drills, and screaming babies. Bean’s mind turns to thoughts of revenge….

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean is left in peace when Mrs Wicket goes off on her holidays. This means Mr Bean has free access to her daily newspaper. But every time he goes down to collect it from the letterbox it disappears. Someone is taking it but who? Mr Bean is determined to nab the mysterious newspaper stealer and uses a range of ingenious homemade traps in his quest to catch the sneaky thief.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 4
programme.desc: Tom and Jerry are hired to find a missing priceless Maltese Pigeon.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 4
programme.desc: Tom enlists the help of the lake monster to terrorize the mouse village forcing Jerry Van Mouseling to intervene and save the day.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 4
programme.desc: Mice visitors from Mars force Tom to change the way he treats Jerry.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy watches a demonstration of balloon modelling on TV. He decides to make a balloon poodle to offer to the she-bear he's enamored with. By observing Grizzy, the Lemmings discover with enthusiasm that you can blow up modelling balloons far more than regular ones, and that they end up exploding in a shower of tattered strips.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy needs a nice nap. He can't find a pillow comfortable enough to his taste until he tests the pillow that the Lemmings use as a high-jump mat. The pillow is so soft that Grizzy falls asleep the second he lays his head on it.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy is awakened from his nap by the unpleasant, ongoing sound of Velcro strips being ripped off. The Lemmings have covered their bodies in Velcro and are throwing themselves against a doormat, which serves as their target. Grizzy finds peace and quiet by getting rid of the doormat until the Lemmings realize that bear fur is an ideal support for Velcro.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The she-bear Grizzy is enamored with has lost her favorite flower in an inaccessible spot under a giant boulder. Grizzy tries to lift it: impossible! He decides to start an intensive bodybuilding routine with the ranger's electrostimulation machine, but the Lemmings are already using it on a caribou to step up their rodeo.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings try to catch a bat to play rodeo, disturbing Grizzy as he plays his favorite game on the ranger's mobile. But when the phone is hit and its alarm activated, a submarine sonar sound is emitted. When the bat hears it, it seems to become docile.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings have a blast testing every app on the ranger's tablet one by one. Grizzy, who is starving, sees that the cupboards are bare. When he realizes that one GPS app can give the itinerary to the nearest chocolate spread store, Grizzy requisitions the tablet.

programme.title: SuperThings: Rivals of Kaboom - Kazoom Power - Season 1
programme.desc: Kai suffers a streak of bad luck after a fight with Jynx. It's all bad luck until Lucky O'Green reveals how to break the streak.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: Buff trains with Batwing to improve his gracefulness and uses her lessons on a delicate mission against the Riddler.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: Badcomputer captures Bibi and disguises Jestah to take her place with the Batwheels so that Jestah can steal the Batcomputer’s motherboard. Can Bibi get free in time to unmask the imposter and save the day?

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: When the Legion of Zoom plan to cheat their way to winning the Gotham Grand Prix, the Batwheels zoom into action to ensure the race is won the right way - fair and square !

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: Green Arrow and his Arrowplane, Goldie, come to help Batman take on the Riddler. Batwing is so happy to have another flying vehicle around that she brings Goldie to life and the two become BFFs. But when Goldie eventually has to leave, Batwing learns that saying goodbye doesn't always mean forever!

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 1
programme.desc: Mayor Leghorn hires The Looney Builders to build a water wheel in the forest where Porky worries about a mythical creature named “Big Feet.”

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 1
programme.desc: The Looney Builders build Tibs Squirrel a closet in his tree, but it won’t fit all of Tibs’ stuff and he doesn’t want to get rid of anything.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 1
programme.desc: When The Looney Builders enter a sandcastle building contest, Tweety sees the competition and loses confidence in his idea.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 1
programme.desc: Chef Hector hires The Looney Builders to build him a burger restaurant, but Daffy is so focused on beating his handheld game that he causes major setbacks.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders: Hard Hat Time - Season 1
programme.desc: Porky tries to eat his sandwich but keeps getting interrupted by the crew who need his help.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean helps Mrs Wicket collect up all her money together after she witnesses a robbery. With all her cash safely locked in a bank vault Mrs Wicket suddenly finds she has a new admirer but Mr Bean doesn’t trust this smooth operator one bit. With wedding bells ringing Mr Bean races against time to solve the mystery and save Mrs Wicket…and her money.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean loves Halloween and prepares to give the neighbourhood kids some tricks and treats they won’t forget. But when Mr Bean gets carried away with his spooky pranks he becomes the target of even more fiendish tricks from his neighbours the Bruisers.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is watching Clint Chiseljaw - his favourite action TV show - with Billy, but Mrs Wicket orders her nephew downstairs to finish his chores. Inspired by Clint’s catchphrase – “Nobody gets left behind”, Mr Bean tries a variety of different daring plans to break Billy out of Mrs Wicket’s flat. But none of them work, until he hits on the perfect plan… or so he thinks!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean peers through the window of the opening party of an art exhibition and sees free snacks being handed around – yum! But he’s told by the bouncer that he needs to be smartly dressed. So he sneaks into the artist’s studio and paints a tuxedo onto himself. This time he’s let in, but will Bean’s fake painted suit last long enough for him to get his free food?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings clumsily destroy the TV remote control while fighting over who gets to watch their favorite program. While looking for a backup zapper, they happen onto a top secret Canadian Army prototype that enables you to apply the usual controls: play, pause and fast forward to living beings.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings discover that by changing the speed limit sign on the side of the road, they can accelerate truck traffic and create a huge draft that is just perfect for their extreme kiting game. Grizzy would be more in favor of a 20261119234500 +0000! or No Entrance! sign. A road sign battle begins.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: While trying to stop the Lemmings from playing their extreme trampoline game, Grizzy slips on the canvas and unwittingly executes an amazing somersault in front of his beloved she-bear. Seeing that she wants more, Grizzy decides to become a champ in the sport. But for that to happen, the Lemmings will need to let him work out.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings have hitched up a racoon with a sweet tooth to their sled and get a ride by throwing cookies in front of the creature with a sling. To recover the supply of cookies, which were to be his afternoon snack, Grizzy has no qualms about making the Lemmings' sled skid out of control. When the sled hits a superhero's spacecraft, a mysterious costume falls out.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings have unearthed a strange little gadget from amongst the Forest Ranger's belongings: a hand spinner. Grizzy thinks it's a silly game until he accidentally tries out the contraption for himself and becomes instantly addicted. What is the secret of this seemingly banal object that make the heads of its enthusiasts spin as well?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings play with poseable figurines of wild Canadian animals. When Grizzy sees that the bear figurine has been put inside a little cage, whereas those of the Lemmings are gathered around a mini-jar of chocolate spread, he decides to join in the party and take control of his own figurine.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy discovers a new generation Tamagotchi game on the Ranger's tablet: the camera scans the player and gives him a virtual avatar of himself to take care of. You must feed it, put it to bed, play with it... Grizzy takes his new responsibility as a parent very seriously, but the Lemmings decide to complete the virtual Grizzy's education with far more intense activities.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings find a native American Indian vase with a genie inside that will make anyone's dreams come true, if they only let him out by rubbing the vase. There is nonetheless one little snag: the effects of the genie's magic instantly wear off as soon as he returns to his vase and the lid shuts.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings get their hands on a secret weapon that belongs to the Canadian Army: anyone hit with it becomes non-violent. They use the arm to transform Grizzy into a cherub, despite himself.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: When they discover a super fun app that allows you to see yourself as a rabbit or a robot or something else decked out with lots of animated accessories, Grizzy and the Lemmings fight over the tablet. But if they insist on arguing and refuse to share their virtual costumes, they could end up smashing each other's faces in for real.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: When they find an old book on traditional Japanese origami, the Lemmings churn out paper birds to play gliding games. Grizzy realizes that he could make the gorgeous butterfly on the cover for his beloved she-bear. But to make the Lemmings bow to his authority, he will first have to become a true origami master.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings are all lined up on the couch to watch a cartoon film where a mouse plays nasty tricks on a cat. Grizzy, who has decided to take his nap, switches off the TV and confiscates the batteries of the remote control to make sure they can't switch their program back on. But is it wise to frustrate a gang of Lemmings who've been inspired by a gag-filled cartoon?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Once again, Grizzy shows the Lemmings that they just don't measure up to him physically and that the last jar of chocolate spread is for the strongest. The Lemmings find a way around this by increasing the power of a lamp that accelerates plant growth and instantly expand themselves to... bear size.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings lay their hands on a full crate of chocolate spread, which they hide somewhere behind Grizzy's back. And since the Lemmings are both prudent and cunning, it's impossible to surprise them when they pay a visit to their secret hoard. Until the day Grizzy discovers a magic ring that enables him to take on the appearance of a Lemming.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy is persuaded that he's discovered the ultimate gadget for good living: a pair of connected glasses for watching TV in panoramic view, with all sorts of indicators, namely an intrusion warning signal. There is only one real drawback: the speedometer function which the Lemmings adore.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is bored of queuing for a trampoline park, so secretly bounces in through a window using a trampette. But he soon gets on the wrong side of a young show-off boy who keeps stealing Teddy and throwing him in hard-to-reach spots. To settle their row, they agree on a race around the trampoline park – first place wins Teddy. Will Mr Bean triumph before he’s chucked out for jumping the queue?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Irma is struggling to sell items from her knitwear stall at the market, so sends Mr Bean to collect a sheep costume he can wear to attract customers. Once at the fancy dress shop however, Mr Bean gets stuck in the sheep costume and has to travel back to the market wearing it. Things go from bad to worse when Mr Bean takes a short cut across the field and gets caught up in a flock of real sheep!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean spots a rare book - the Teddy Bear Haunting - in a bookshop, but it’s too expensive to buy. He secretly tries to read it in the shop… until he’s thrown out. To his dismay someone else then buys the book – so he follows the buyer around trying to read over his shoulder. Will Mr Bean manage to get to the end of the book before getting spotted?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean and Teddy are enjoying a day at the arcade, when Mr Bean gets carried away with the dance machine, knocking Teddy onto the floor. Teddy’s picked up, put on a trolley of stuffed toys and figurines – and soon enough, he’s been put in the claw machine as a prize! Mr Bean has run out of coins, so has to find a way of winning Teddy back without looking like he’s cheating!

programme.title: Lamput - Season 3
programme.desc: It's Specs big night in the town with the lady of his dream. What could go wrong? The answer to that question might have do with the shapeshifting orange blob at the next table.

programme.title: Moley - Season 1
programme.desc: All of MoleTown enjoys a day at the beach. But when they found out Mona Lisa can’t swim, Mishmosh comes to the rescue with his new submarine invention!

programme.title: Moley - Season 1
programme.desc: MoleTown’s orchestra is performing, and everyone is impressed with Milo’s new hat until Moley accidentally breaks it. Moley must come up with a way to get Milo’s hat back to normal and fast!

programme.title: Moley - Season 1
programme.desc: When the Gardener finally gets his hands on Manny, Moley and Dotty are on his trail, so he dresses up as the world’s greatest Mole detective and lead them away from the clues.

programme.title: Moley - Season 1

programme.desc: After being zapped by Penguin's Songinator ray, the Batwheels find themselves only able to communicate through song! They'll need to learn to harmonize as a team to defeat the musical prankster.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 1
programme.desc: As The Looney Builders help Petunia build a greenhouse, she can’t wait for the veggies to grow and does everything she can to speed up the process.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 1
programme.desc: The Looney Builders prepare to host a big holiday lights festival in Looneyburg Park when an unexpected snowstorm prevents Looneyburgers from attending.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 1
programme.desc: The Looney Builders prepare to host a big holiday lights festival in Looneyburg Park when an unexpected snowstorm prevents Looneyburgers from attending.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 1
programme.desc: When Marvin the Martian crash lands in Looneyburg, he’s in a hurry to leave and hires The Looney Builders to build him a spaceship.

programme.title: Tom and Jerry - Season 1
programme.desc: Tom And Jerry zip along Singapore’s vibrant riverside and make a new friend – Merli! Will Merli succeed in being the maestro of peace between the two?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean is painting a picture of Teddy when he accidently squirts some green paint onto his brown wallpaper. Oh no! Bean needs to redecorate his room fast but ends up painting all the walls a garish lime green instead of brown. He’s so terrified of Mrs Wicket finding out that when he goes to bed he has some very weird nightmares – with a rather sickly ending.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean is no fan of wrestling. But he’s promised to take Mrs Wicket and her friend Mrs Wince to a big wrestling match in town. Bean finds himself lost backstage at the stadium and accidentally wanders through a door and straight into the wrestling ring where he finds himself up against Side Kick Rick. More by luck than talent Bean wins the match – only to find that now he has to fight the terrifying Bruise Force.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is trying to watch the motor racing on TV, when Mrs Wicket interrupts him to offer a deal – revamp her garden with new paving and ornaments, and he’ll get a month’s rent for free. Bean reluctantly agrees, but when he sees Mr Paliwal finish a personal training session and keen for more, he offers him a new workout… doing all Mr Bean’s work for him while he watches the racing! Win, win!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is bored of queuing for a trampoline park, so secretly bounces in through a window using a trampette. But he soon gets on the wrong side of a young show-off boy who keeps stealing Teddy and throwing him in hard-to-reach spots. To settle their row, they agree on a race around the trampoline park – first place wins Teddy. Will Mr Bean triumph before he’s chucked out for jumping the queue?

programme.title: Lamput - Season 3
programme.desc: Lamput faints of thirst on a desert highway, so already it’s not a great day for the little orange shape-shifter. Add to that the fact that Specs and Skinny just happen by in a lockup van, and things go south pretty promptly. Specs and Skinny learn a valuable lesson: maybe if you’re going to anger a morphing super-blob by throwing them in the back of a van and withholding precious water, you shouldn’t do it whilst driving by a 100 foot cliff drop down to the open ocean. Hopefully these Docs are better swimmers than your average academic.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings clamor for their turn to play with the ranger's mobile phone, but Grizzy isn't in the sharing mood. And he's very talented at flattening anything that comes near, without looking up from his game. The Lemmings invent an implacable protection system which should enable them to recover the mobile in complete safety.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy is captivated by a mime artist on TV who makes viewers believe in the presence of an invisible wall. To get rid of the Lemmings, who have sights on his jar of Yummy, Grizzy hides the jar and pretends he has an invisible one. When the Lemmings see through the trick, they decide to trap Grizzy with a grand illusion number.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings shiver with cold, sneeze and are glassy-eyed: they have a big fat cold! They look so pitiful that Grizzy doesn't have the heart to throw them into the void, even if they are extremely annoying when they try to snuggle up to him to keep warm. He decides to heal them: the quicker they get better, the quicker Grizzy will be able to get rid of them pitilessly.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings find a pack of icy mints that literally chill your breath. One blast from anyone who eats them freezes everything in sight. Grizzy does not particularly care for this frosty ambiance and tries to take their candy away.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy can't believe it: he has just swallowed a spoonful of his favorite food, chocolate spread, and he hates it! How could that be possible? And yet, when he swiped the jar from the Lemmings, they seemed to be enjoying it immensely. A quick investigation reveals that the Lemmings added a dash of lemon juice to the jar to give the spread a sharper taste. And they intend to jazz up the rest of the stock as well!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy discovers the fondness of his beloved she-bear for meditation. To seduce her, he sets out to prove to her that he too can attain the Zen attitude. This demands practice, of course, but it especially demands lots of willpower and concentration to get rid of the rowdy Lemmings without losing one's temper.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings discover a super-secret Canadian Army prototype which resembles a simple computer keyboard. It has only several command keys: select, cut and paste, and delete, but the keys act directly on surrounding elements... as well as on living beings!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings are having a blast with a bowling game they found in the Ranger's storeroom. Grizzy hastens to destroy the pins to ensure his peace and quiet. But the Lemmings discover a remote-control device that can modify the ball's weight. By setting it on maximum, the ball could knock over much more than pins: furniture, a bear and even a log cabin!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: After the rains, to the great delight of the Lemmings, strange bouncing mushrooms have sprouted in the yard. To put an end to the Lemmings' noisy games - which prevent Grizzy from enjoying his peace and quiet - Grizzy tramples the mushrooms. Only to realize that each crushed mushroom frees a cloud of spores that instantly creates... a bunch of identical mushrooms.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings have laid hand on special magnets which turn any object they are stuck to into flying objects. Grizzy bears the consequences and is ejected out of the cabin on his couch, which has turned into a flying-couch. Upon landing, Grizzy discovers by chance that the magnet stuck to his forehead enables him to fly like Peter Pan.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: With a lion-tamer's whip, a sugar bowl and lots of work, the Lemmings have successfully trained a caribou to go through their obstacle course. Grizzy cannot help but admire the performance. He decides to steal their idea, and the caribou, to create his own circus act and impress his lovely she-bear.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy happens onto the electronic version of the Ranger Lemming toy which is capable of reproducing the movements one teaches it, like a smart robot. Grizzy immediately grasps the potential of a robot that could perform chores with rapidity and precision, but the Lemmings would rather teach it to dance.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Ranger's cabin is equipped with an ultra-effective pest detector capable of sensing the presence of an intruder, then chasing it out by emitting a wave that instructs the creature's brain to leave at once. Grizzy and the Lemmings are no longer able to stay inside, until they discover that the box's remote-control device allows you to select which type of animal will be spared or targeted by the wave.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy finds himself unwillingly caught up in a race between two teams of Lemmings. When he understands the stakes, he tries to win but loses. Grizzy has his pride: he wants a rematch. He decides to build his own racing machine to challenge the Lemmings' soapbox.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings have placed giant remote-controlled hydraulic jacks under the cabin to transform it into a life-sized rolling ball game. Grizzy, who in inclined to seasickness, tries to put things back in place. The cabin tips over into empty space.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean and Teddy are looking forward to seeing a once-in-a-lifetime comet – but it won’t appear until 4am! He tries to stay up, but it’s useless – he keeps dropping off. So instead, Mr Bean decides to go to bed and set an alarm – yet he over-winds the clock and it breaks! With all the shops closed, his only option is to build his own complicated version to make sure he doesn’t miss the comet…

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mrs Wicket makes Mr Bean drive her to the hospital to get her ingrown toenail seen to and asks him to wait. Mr Bean gets bored, and on a wander around the hospital he finds a spare doctor’s outfit with stethoscope – great Teddy - I’ll give you a check-up! But a nurse spots him, and thinking he’s a new doctor Mr Bean is asked to visit patients. How long can he keep it up before he’s found out?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is at the supermarket when he spots a cool fire engine ride – but the security guard makes it clear it’s for little kids only. Not to be deterred, Mr Bean tries everything he can to distract the guard to have his go on the ride. When he finally does get his go, it’s not as good as he thought it would be, especially when a real fire engine has to be called to help Mr Bean!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean receives a delivery of a bunch of flowers for Mrs Wicket, but accidentally runs them over in the his car. He can’t afford to replace them, so he decides to recreate the bunch by taking flowers one by one from anywhere he can - a vase in a café, a wedding bouquet, even from between the teeth of a tango dancer! But will he assemble the bunch and be back in time for Mrs Wicket?

programme.title: Lamput - Season 3
programme.desc: It's back to basics as Specs attempts to catch Lamput with a net. Not being much good at anything at all physical, Specs ends up whacking himself on his own noggin. The blow shakes loose what little ability Specs had to function as an adult. He's transformed into a wailing infant who requires 24 hour care from his devoted... parents? Skinny and Lamput have to learn on the job. Taking care of a baby is hard. Especially if it's a giant annoying one.

Maya advocates for herself and her career, while Jack becomes more intertwined with an acquaintance; and Andy and Ryan have a heart-to-heart.

programme.title: Pasauļu karš
programme.desc: Kamēr Aila pārdomā Bila patiesos motīvus, viņš vēršas pie Zojas ar lūgumu, kas grupā izraisa kārtējo saspringto konfrontāciju.

programme.title: Pasauļu karš
programme.desc: Atkalapvienojušies Londonā, Ketrīna un Bils dalās zināšanās par citplanētiešiem un izdara satriecošu atklājumu par to, kā šī ārpuszemes civilizācija radusies.

programme.title: Saules pretstati
programme.desc: Gadu pēc tam, kad citplanētieši Korvo, Terija un viņu bērni - replikanti Jumiulaks un Džesija - ir aizbēguši no savas planētas Šlorpas iznīcināšanas un nokļuvuši uz Zemes, viņi pielāgojas jaunajai dzīvei un sadraudzējas ar cilvēkiem Travisu un Everiju. Atklājas, ka viņu mājdzīvnieks Pupa kādu dienu attīstīsies un iznīcinās Zemi, lai izveidotu jaunu Šlorpu.

programme.title: Saules pretstati
programme.desc: Kad Pupa kļūst oranžs, Korvo saprot, ka viņš savā makā uz Šlora ir atstājis svarīgu informāciju par Pupu. Viņš un Terija dodas atpakaļ pagātnē dienā, kad viņi evakuējās no Šlorpas, un iemet Korvo maku savā kosmosa kuģī. Atgriežoties tagadnē, viņi saprot, ka Pupa tikai apēda kaut ko oranžu, bet laika plūsma ir izmainīta, un tagad viņi dzīvo kopā ar Vanbo, nepatīkamu šlorpieti.

programme.desc: Ketrīnu satricina jauni atklājumi, bet Londonā izdzīvojušie uzsāk cīņu pret iebrucējiem. Emīlijas atgriešanās vieš cerību, taču pēc ilgās prombūtnes ne visi ir pārliecināti, ka viņa joprojām ir viņu pusē…

Devon and Kit treat a patient who suffers from sickle cell anemia and encourage her to have a hip replacement to help treat her pain. Meanwhile, The Raptor is pulled away in the middle of an intense surgery, Mina is left to put her skills and finish the surgery on her own and Bell works on reconnecting with his stepson after helping him get hired at the hospital.

programme.title: Rezidents
programme.desc: When Cain’s elective surgery patient returns with complications, Mina and Raptor butt heads over how to handle the situation. In the wake of losing many colleagues to the virus, Bell worries who would be there for him in a moment of crisis and finds himself mining his own past to find his estranged former stepson, elite plastic surgeon Dr. Jake Wong (guest star Conrad Ricamora). Meanwhile, Logan Kim finds himself on the chopping block when the doctors are questioned about his actions during the pandemic.

programme.title: Rezidents
programme.desc: When Cain tries to be a hero at a crash scene, he is struck by a car, causing Chastain’s doctors to put aside their personal issues to try and save his life. Conrad and Nic team up to help one of the crash victims, whose secretive past makes it difficult to identify a diagnosis. Meanwhile, Bell brings his TV crew to the hospital in hopes of garnering positive attention for Chastain, and Mina opens up to Nic, only to find out that Nic is holding on to a secret of her own.

programme.title: 19. ugunsdzēsēju depo
programme.desc: While Pruitt grieves a monumental loss, Andy refuses to do the same and, instead, throws herself into work. Meanwhile, the crew responds to a widespread carbon monoxide leak, and Sullivan makes a controversial choice for captain.

programme.title: Pasauļu karš
programme.desc: Izdzīvojušie gatavojas uzbrukumam, kas var mainīt visu. Uz Bila pleciem gulstas visas pasaules liktenis, bet vai viņš spēs uzņemties atbildību brīdī, kad no viņa būs atkarīga visas cilvēces izdzīvošana?

programme.title: Pasauļu karš
programme.desc: Tā kā cilvēki visā pasaulē piedzīvo halucinācijas, MI5 aģente Zoja sazinās ar Bilu, lai saņemtu atbildes; Katrīna Duranda atklāj neparastu melnā cauruma aktivitāti.

programme.title: Saules pretstati
programme.desc: Korvo, kuru arvien vairāk sarūgtina Terija, izmet sarkano Goobleru - stresa izraisītu radījumu, kas vēlas nogalināt Korvo. Viņi nopērk ūdens motociklu no Trenta, kurš tiek nogalināts ar Goobleru. Nomedījuši radījumu Helovīna veikalā, viņi to sašaurina un notver. Skolā Džesija atklāj, ka viņai uz galvas aug zieds, kas izdala ziedputekšņus, kas līdzinās MDMA, liekot populārajām meitenēm viņu iemīlēt.

programme.title: M.O.D.O.K
programme.desc: Super villain M.O.D.O.K. runs his evil organization AIM into the ground and is forced to sell it to the tech company GRUMBL. As the megalomaniacal M.O.D.O.K. struggles to regain control of AIM, he risks losing something even more important…his family!

programme.title: M.O.D.O.K
programme.desc: In a bid to save his marriage, M.O.D.O.K. takes Jodie back in time to a concert they missed when they were in college. During a detour to kill the child-version of his GRUMBL boss, M.O.D.O.K. and Jodie are attacked by college-aged M.O.D.O.K., who accidentally absorbs their time crystals, stranding them in 2002. The couple reconciles but is stuck in the past until they catch up to the present. Once in the present, they prevent themselves from ever going to the past in the first place, erasing their entire adventure from the timeline.

programme.title: Pasauļu karš
programme.desc: Bils arvien vairāk raizējas par Emīlijas pārsteidzošo līdzību ar citplanētiešiem, savukārt uzbrukums observatorijai Ketrīnai sagādā smagu triecienu.

programme.title: Rezidents
programme.desc: When Cain’s elective surgery patient returns with complications, Mina and Raptor butt heads over how to handle the situation. Conrad and Devon treat a local Congresswoman who withholds information that could prevent her from receiving proper treatment, causing Devon to open up about his grief. In the wake of losing many colleagues to the virus, Bell worries who would be there for him in a moment of crisis and finds himself mining his own past to find his estranged former stepson, elite plastic surgeon Dr. Jake Wong (guest star Conrad Ricamora). Meanwhile, Logan Kim finds himself on the chopping block when the doctors are questioned about his actions during the pandemic.

programme.title: Grejas anatomija
programme.desc: Beilija liek interniem veidot virkni videoklipu sociālajos plašsaziņas līdzekļos, informējot pusaudžus par seksuālo veselību. Šie videoklipi, kas tiek uzņemti Greja Slona slimnīcā vidusskolēnu grupas priekšā, kļūst īpaši aktuāli, kad apmeklējuma laikā kādai skolniecei rodas medicīniski sarežģījumi. Meredita un Megija uzzina ko jaunu par Zolu.

programme.title: Grejas anatomija
programme.desc: Greja Slona slimnīcā tiek atzīmēta Helovīna nakts. Meredita un Niks cenšas pavadīt laiku vienatnē; Levijs cīnās ar stresu pārpūles dēļ, savukārt Vinstons un Ouens liek interniem trenēties traumatoloģijā uz īsta līķa.

programme.title: Grejas anatomija
programme.desc: Beilija un Edisona dodas ceļā, lai brīvprātīgi strādātu ģimenes plānošanas centrā, taču pacientes ārpusdzemdes grūtniecība izraisa sarežģījumus. Interni cenšas noskaidrot patiesību par Lūkasa attiecībām ar Amēliju, savukārt Meredita sastop Džeksonu ceļojuma laikā uz Bostonu.

programme.title: Pasauļu karš
programme.desc: Ar Ričarda palīdzību Katrīna atklāj, ka var ceļot uz citu pasauli; jauna atklāsme pārbauda Martas lojalitāti; Zoja atbrīvo Bilu no cietuma.

programme.title: Saules pretstati 2
programme.desc: Vakariņu laiks! Korvo iegūst galveno balvu ikgadējā apkaimes ribiņu festivālā.

programme.title: Saules pretstati
programme.desc: Gadu pēc tam, kad citplanētieši Korvo, Terija un viņu bērni - replikanti Jumiulaks un Džesija - ir aizbēguši no savas planētas Šlorpas iznīcināšanas un nokļuvuši uz Zemes, viņi pielāgojas jaunajai dzīvei un sadraudzējas ar cilvēkiem Travisu un Everiju. Atklājas, ka viņu mājdzīvnieks Pupa kādu dienu attīstīsies un iznīcinās Zemi, lai izveidotu jaunu Šlorpu.

programme.title: Saules pretstati
programme.desc: Korvo un Terija ievieto nanobotus pilsētas ūdensapgādē, lai izspiegotu savus kaimiņus. Uzzinājuši, ka viņus nelabvēlīgi uztver, Korvo un Terija izmanto no nanobotiem iegūto informāciju, lai iekarotu sabiedrību un kandidētu uz mājas īpašnieku asociācijas prezidenta amatu. Nanoboti izveido personību, kas arī kandidē uz prezidenta amatu.

programme.title: Saules pretstati
programme.desc: Pakļauti izslēgšanas draudiem, Jumiulaks un Džesija pēc mācību gada beigām turpina apmeklēt savu tukšo vidusskolu. Nezinot par vasaras brīvlaiku, viņi uzskata, ka tiek pārbaudīti, un mēģina mācīt viens otru. Viņi saprot savu kļūdu un nodara postījumus skolā. Korvo un Terija ierodas junioru koledžā, bet Terija nošauj Korvo ar staru lielgabalu, kas padara viņu vēl dumjāku.

programme.title: Saules pretstati
programme.desc: Gadu pēc tam, kad citplanētieši Korvo, Terija un viņu bērni - replikanti Jumiulaks un Džesija - ir aizbēguši no savas planētas Šlorpas iznīcināšanas un nokļuvuši uz Zemes, viņi pielāgojas jaunajai dzīvei un sadraudzējas ar cilvēkiem Travisu un Everiju. Atklājas, ka viņu mājdzīvnieks Pupa kādu dienu attīstīsies un iznīcinās Zemi, lai izveidotu jaunu Šlorpu.

programme.desc: Lou, feeling like M.O.D.O.K. is stifling his individuality ahead of his bar mitzvah, jumps into M.O.D.O.K.’s portal to Asgard. He refuses to go back home with his dad, so M.O.D.O.K. takes control of an army of Asgardian warriors and wages war against his son. Eventually, M.O.D.O.K. and Lou strike a deal and use Lou's magic tricks to pacify the Kobolds. Meanwhile, the Super Adaptoid agrees to help young M.O.D.O.K.

programme.title: Ledus laikmets 3: Dinozauru ēra
programme.desc: Kas var būt lieliskāks par vismīļāko aizvēsturisko draugu atgriešanos? Šoreiz Manijs ar biedriem atklāj zudušu pasauli, kurā mājo zvērīgi dinozauri. To vidū ir arī īdzīgs tiranozaurs, kam kārtojami īpaši rēķini ar sliņķi Sidu. Arī smieklīgā vāverēna dzīvē pienācis pārmaiņu laiks – viņš sastop neatvairāmi daiļu vāveru jaunkundzi, bet nekad jau nevar tā īsti zināt, vai dāma alkst nolaupīt viņa sirdi vai kvēli dievināto zīli.

programme.title: Cietais rieksts
programme.desc: Šajā spriedzes trillerī, kas pacēla latiņu šī žanra filmām, Brūss Viliss atveido Ņujorkas policistu Džonu Makleinu, kurš Losandželosā ir ieradies pavadīt brīvdienas ar savu sievu Holiju. Bet, kamēr Makleins gaida, līdz beigsies Holijas darba ballīte, ēkā iebrūk teroristi. Grupējuma vadonis Hanss Grūbers ar saviem padotajiem sagrābj ķīlniekus, bet Makleins tikmēr gatavojas pieteikt viena cilvēka karu, un uzvarēt tajā var tikai Makleins!

programme.title: Cietais rieksts 2
programme.desc: gadā „Oskaram” nominētās cikla pirmās filmas turpinājums. Ņujorkas policists, tagad Losandželosas policijas darbinieks, Džons Makleins lidostā gaida savu sievu, kad pēkšņi ēkā iebrūk bruņoti tipi, kuri vēlas izglābt narkotirgoni, kas ir nogādāts ASV, lai tur stātos tiesas priekšā.
